<js>
r=java.getString(".content@html")
result=r
if (java.getString("text",r)!=""&&r!=""){
	book.type=8
	}
else if (java.getString("text",r)==""&&r!=""){
	book.type=64
	}else if (r==""){
		try{
			if (chapter.index==0){java.toast("如正文为链接，返回重进自动切换为听书模式")}
			book.type=32

		}catch(e){
			java.log(e)
			result="未找到内容"
			java.toast(result)
			}
	}
result
</js>

ruleToc.chapterName:
<js>
$=result;
title=$.chaptername;
title=String(title).replace(/^\s+/,'');
intro=$.chapterintro;
java.put("intro",intro);
vip=$.isvip!='0';
lock=$.islock!='0';
type=$.chaptertype=='1';
num=!type?'第{{$.chapterid}}章 ':'';
if(title.match(/[一二三四五六七八九十百千万\d]+\s*章|^\d+[、\.\s]|chapter\s*\d+/i)){
num=''
}else{num=num}
l=lock?'[锁]':'';
result=num+title+l;

//不显示卷名
result=!type?result:'';
</js>

ruleContent.nextContentUrl:
<js>
if(baseUrl.match(/page=/)){
result=""
}else{
allpage=result.match(/'redtext'>([^<]+)<\/span>页/)[1];
list=[];

len=allpage>10?10:allpage;

start=1;end=len;
java.log("end0: "+end)
if(book.getVariable("custom")!=""){
start=Number(book.getVariable("custom").match(/(\d+)-\d+/)[1]);
end=Number(book.getVariable("custom").match(/\d+-(\d+)/)[1]);
}
for(i=start;i<=end;i++){
list.push(baseUrl+"&page="+i);
}
list;
}
</js>

source.variableComment:
1、书籍变量（当前书）
填写 [去章节序号] —— 去除章节序号
填写 [目录简介] —— 章节简介放到目录列表，正文不出现
填写 [评论+评论数量]——如 评论50  则可以显示50条评论，数量必填

2、源变量（所有书）
其余同书籍变量
填写[搜索+书名] —— 必须在第一行，搜索百合书籍，在发现里点击[百合搜索]

更改过后都要重新刷新

if (kind.find(item => item == "VIP")) {
 let userChapNum = java.getString(".MuiStack-root.-4@span@text");
 let userChap = getUserchap1(java.getString(".MuiStack-root.-4@svg!0@data-testid")).split(" ");
 kind = kind.concat(userChap);
 intro = `　已解锁：${userChapNum}章
 ${intro}`;
}

 intro: intro,

};

 result = {}
}

<js>
let self = this, __next_f = [];
let evaljsText = src.match(/self\.__next_f\.push\(\[1,\s*".+?"\]\)/gi).join(";").replace(/\w+\[/g, "[");
eval(evaljsText);
//\\(?!\\|n|u|r|")|  .replace(/(\\){2,}/g, `\\`)
result = __next_f.map(item => item[1]).join("").replace(/\n$/g, ``).split("\n").reduce((arr, item, index) => {
 item = item.replace(/^[\d\w]{1,3}:/, "");
 try {
  item = JSON.parse(item);
 } catch (err) {
  java.log(index + "  错误    " + item);
  java.log(err);
  item = [];
 }
 // java.log("\n\n" + index + "   ==    " + JSON.stringify(item) + "\n\n")
 try {
  if (item && typeof item[3] == "object" && item[3].book) {
   let _book = item[3];
   if (_book.req) { //发现页userchap
    _book = {
     book: _book.req.data.book_info,
     userchap: [_book.book]
    };
   }
   //java.log( "\n\n  "+index +"    "+JSON.stringify(_book)+"\n\n")
   arr.push(_book);
  }
 } catch (err) {
  java.log(index + "  =错误=   " + item);
  java.log(err);
 }
 return arr
}, []);

})
